title: Solvent-mediated hydrothermal synthesis of K/Bi-doped [Ba(1−x)Kx][Bi(1−y)Tiy]O3 perovskites: structure–property relationships and bandgap engineering
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9890-9904
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00023A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Md. Golam Sarowar, Mirza Humaun Kabir Rubel
Low-temperature hydrothermal synthesis of K/Bi-doped BaTiO3 perovskites with solvent-tunable properties. Water-synthesis yields high crystallinity and thermal stability; wide bandgaps (>4.0 eV) enable UV optoelectronic applications.
